Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?

All three pens have identical black caps and translucent barrels, showing no color mismatch.
Every pen appears fully capped with no exposed tips, and they all appear to be the same length.

The pens remain fixed in their positions on the white board as it slides across the frame.

parsed.reason: The video shows a smooth left-to-right motion of a board carrying three identical, correctly oriented, and capped pens. No anomalies in count, orientation, color, or motion are observed.
